subject: Copywriting
title: BMW: The Ultimate Driving Machine
description: One-minute skill: BMW: The Ultimate Driving Machine.

hook.text: 'The Ultimate Driving Machine.' Six words that positioned BMW as the driver's sport car for 50 years.

buildup.text: Ammirati & Puris coined it in 1973. BMW was unknown in America.

discovery.text: The word 'driving' was the key. Not 'riding' (passive luxury) or 'owning' (status). Driving meant involvement.

twist.text: As BMW moved upmarket, some critics said the cars became less driver-focused.

climax.text: BMW's slogan teaches: the best tagline names the experience, not the product.

punchline.text: Six words since 1973. 'Driving' put the buyer behind the wheel.

quiz.question: Why was the word 'driving' key in BMW's tagline?
options: It implied active involvement rather than passive luxury
